name: Power supplies, chargers and battery packs
note: For power supplies, adapters and chargers, CBP generally finds origin where the main printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), power conversion module or inductive charging module is made; inserting those into housings, soldering wires and connectors, sealing, testing and packing do not change it. For battery products the pool rulings point both ways and no single part always decides: a power bank and a power-tool battery pack took the origin of their cells over a PCBA or cell monitoring board made elsewhere, a pouch cell took the origin of the country that made it from imported electrode materials, and a flow battery took the origin of the country that built its stacks; but a portable power station took the origin of its six PCBAs over its Chinese battery bank. Written from 23 CBP substantial-transformation rulings outside the dev and held-out splits (D138), with six battery rulings from the train and other pools added in version 2 (D782); every battery citation was read against its facts and held origin. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: PCBA (SMT)
operations: populate bare printed circuit boards with integrated circuits, resistors, capacitors, diodes, transistors, and transformers via surface mount technology (SMT) and through-hole insertion
reflow and wave solder components onto the bare boards to create the main power conversion and control PCBAs

precedent.note: CBP holds that the country where bare PCBs are populated and soldered into functional power conversion and control PCBAs confers origin (N331901, N344179, N346631, N349313); a portable power station whose six PCBAs, battery protection board included, were made in Vietnam was held Vietnamese though it was assembled in China with Chinese batteries (N348871). For power banks and a power-tool battery pack the PCBA did not decide: a Vietnamese SMT PCBA (N346317, N346403) and a Chinese cell monitoring board (N347193) left the origin with the cells.

groups.name: Power conversion or charging module
operations: manufacture the inductive or magnetic wireless charging module
assemble the IGBT module, switching mode power supply (SMPS) module, or inductor kit

precedent.note: Manufacturing the core power conversion module (such as an SMPS or IGBT module) or inductive charging module confers origin when combined with the PCBA or control board (N333268, N342133, N347058, N349537), though a foreign inverter block alone did not outweigh domestic manufacturing of eight PCBAs and system integration in N349313. A Japanese inverter did not make Japan the origin of a portable power station whose other boards were Vietnamese (N348871).

groups.name: Housing, cables and minor parts
operations: mold plastic housings and module covers
fabricate or cast metal enclosures, electrical chassis, busbars, and heat sinks
draw and insulate copper conductors to form electrical cables and wire harnesses
solder male and female USB connectors, vehicle plugs, or terminal clamps onto cable ends

precedent.note: Producing the plastic molded housing, cast aluminum enclosure, or metal chassis and busbars is not enough to confer origin when the core power conversion modules and PCBAs originate in another country (N342133, N347058, N349537).

groups.name: Battery cells and cell stacks
operations: mix electrode slurry from active materials, binders and conductive agents, coat it on foil, calender and slit the electrode rolls
notch the electrodes, stack or wind them with separators, weld the tabs, fill electrolyte and seal the cell
form, degas, test and grade the cells
build flow-battery stacks from felt, membrane, bipolar plates and frames, then compress and test them

precedent.note: Making the cell from imported electrode materials (slurry, coating, stacking, electrolyte filling, formation) made South Korea the origin of a pouch cell (N347172); a power-tool battery pack took its cells' origin, whichever of three countries made them (N347193); power banks assembled in Vietnam took the origin of their Chinese cells (N346317, N346403); and building the stacks of a flow battery in the United Kingdom was part of what made it British (N342506). The cells did not decide for a portable power station: Chinese batteries did not outweigh six Vietnamese PCBAs (N348871).

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: program the PCBA and solder internal wires and cables to the PCBA and plug terminals
mount the PCBA, charging module, fan, and heat sinks into the plastic housing or metal enclosure
seal the housing via ultrasonic welding or fasten the chassis with bolts and screws
perform electrical testing, calibration, debugging, visual inspection, and retail packaging with cables

precedent.note: Final assembly, programming, wire soldering, enclosure sealing and packaging do not confer origin when the PCBA and power or charging modules are imported (N333268, N347058, N349537). For battery products: testing and sorting cells, pressing them into holders, welding contact plates and the monitoring board and closing the housing did not (N347193), nor did mounting a PCBA and an imported cell in a housing (N346317, N346403), nor assembling a portable power station in China from Vietnamese boards (N348871); integrating locally built stacks into a flow-battery system did, with the stacks (N342506).
